{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CINotifier where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as LBS
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import Data.Char (ord, chr, isAlphaNum, isSpace)
import Network.HTTP.Types (status200, status400)
import Network.Wai (Application, Request, requestHeaders, responseLBS, rawPathInfo, lazyRequestBody)
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp (run)
import System.Process (callCommand)
import System.IO (hClose, hPutStr)
import System.IO.Temp (withSystemTempFile)
import System.FilePath ()
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- CI/CD notification service behind nginx reverse proxy
-- Sends email notifications on build completion

type HeaderStore = IORef (Map.Map String String)

-- Nginx passes the original requester's email via X-Authenticated-Email
-- and the build branch via X-Build-Ref

data BuildEvent = BuildEvent
  { buildBranch :: String
  , buildStatus :: String
  , commitAuthor :: String
  , notifyEmail :: String
  } deriving (Show)

-- Decode percent-encoded sequences from proxy headers
decodeProxyHeader :: String -> String
decodeProxyHeader [] = []
decodeProxyHeader ('%':h1:h2:rest) = chr (hexVal h1 * 16 + hexVal h2) : decodeProxyHeader rest
decodeProxyHeader (c:rest) = c : decodeProxyHeader rest

hexVal :: Char -> Int
hexVal c
  | c >= '0' && c <= '9' = ord c - ord '0'
  | c >= 'a' && c <= 'f' = ord c - ord 'a' + 10
  | c >= 'A' && c <= 'F' = ord c - ord 'A' + 10
  | otherwise = 0

-- Validate email format - checks for injection characters
-- This runs AFTER percent-decoding in the pipeline
validateEmailDecoded :: String -> Bool
validateEmailDecoded email =
  not (any (\c -> c == '\n' || c == '\r') email)
  && '@' `elem` email
  && not (isInfixOf ".." email)
  && length email < 255

-- Sanitize branch name for display
sanitizeBranch :: String -> String
sanitizeBranch = filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '/' || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.')

-- Sanitize free-text fields to prevent header injection
sanitizeHeaderValue :: String -> String
sanitizeHeaderValue = filter (\c -> c /= '\n' && c /= '\r')

-- Build the email command using sendmail
-- The notify address comes from the authenticated proxy header
buildEmailPayload :: BuildEvent -> String
buildEmailPayload evt =
  "From: ci-system@internal.corp\r\n"
  ++ "To: " ++ notifyEmail evt ++ "\r\n"
  ++ "Subject: Build " ++ buildStatus evt ++ " - " ++ sanitizeBranch (buildBranch evt) ++ "\r\n"
  ++ "X-CI-Branch: " ++ sanitizeBranch (buildBranch evt) ++ "\r\n"
  ++ "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\n"
  ++ "\r\n"
  ++ "Build " ++ buildStatus evt ++ " for branch: " ++ sanitizeBranch (buildBranch evt) ++ "\n"
  ++ "Author: " ++ sanitizeHeaderValue (commitAuthor evt) ++ "\n"

-- Send notification via sendmail
-- Uses a securely created unique temp file (O_EXCL, restrictive perms)
-- to avoid symlink attacks and races on a predictable path.
sendNotification :: BuildEvent -> IO ()
sendNotification evt = do
  let payload = buildEmailPayload evt
  withSystemTempFile "ci_email.txt" $ \path handle -> do
    hPutStr handle payload
    hClose handle
    callCommand ("sendmail -t < " ++ shellQuote path)

-- Safely single-quote a path for use in a shell command
shellQuote :: String -> String
shellQuote s = "'" ++ concatMap escape s ++ "'"
  where
    escape '\'' = "'\\''"
    escape c    = [c]

-- Process incoming webhook from CI runner
-- Headers are set by nginx after authentication
processWebhook :: Request -> IO BuildEvent
processWebhook req = do
  let hdrs = requestHeaders req
  -- nginx sets X-Authenticated-Email after OAuth validation
  let rawEmail = BS.unpack $ fromMaybe "" $ lookup "X-Authenticated-Email" hdrs
  -- nginx sets X-Build-Ref from the CI runner's signed payload
  let rawBranch = BS.unpack $ fromMaybe "main" $ lookup "X-Build-Ref" hdrs
  let rawStatus = BS.unpack $ fromMaybe "unknown" $ lookup "X-Build-Status" hdrs
  let rawAuthor = BS.unpack $ fromMaybe "unknown" $ lookup "X-Commit-Author" hdrs
  
  -- Decode percent-encoding that nginx may apply to header values
  -- containing special characters from upstream OAuth provider
  let decodedEmail = decodeProxyHeader rawEmail
  let decodedBranch = decodeProxyHeader rawBranch
  let decodedAuthor = decodeProxyHeader rawAuthor
  
  -- Validate AFTER decoding to catch encoded injection sequences
  let emailValid = validateEmailDecoded decodedEmail
  
  if not emailValid
    then error "Invalid email in authenticated header"
    else return $ BuildEvent
      { buildBranch = decodedBranch
      , buildStatus = if rawStatus `elem` ["success", "failure", "cancelled"] then rawStatus else "unknown"
      , commitAuthor = sanitizeHeaderValue decodedAuthor
      , notifyEmail = decodedEmail
      }

app :: Application
app req respond = do
  let path = BS.unpack $ rawPathInfo req
  case path of
    "/webhook/build-complete" -> do
      evt <- processWebhook req
      sendNotification evt
      respond $ responseLBS status200 [] "Notification sent"
    _ -> respond $ responseLBS status400 [] "Unknown endpoint"

main :: IO ()
main = run 8080 app
